entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: *spit*

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: ...Hmph. Where'd your energy from earlier go?

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: A peasant like you isn't worth beating.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: I'll have you killed right now.
Stop it!
Have you lost your mind!?

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: What? Don't you dare tell me you don't know who I am.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: That look in your eyes irritates me!

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: Hold him there... After the peasant, it's his turn to die.

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: No... I don't wanna die...

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: No... I don't wanna die...

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: This is truly an unjust game... Your[n]chances of winning are almost none.

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: But if my voice is reaching you, there may[n]yet be a possibility open to you...

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: What's the matter? Are you simply going to watch?

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: Are you forsaking him to save yourself?

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: Death awaits him if you do nothing.

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: Was your previous decision a mistake then?

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: Was it a mistake!?
It wasn't.
It might have been...

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: No need for mere words. Show me your true feelings.

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: *chuckle* Yes, that's it!
N-Nnngh...! Gaaaah!

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: Very well... I have heeded your resolve.

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: Vow to me.

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: I am thou, thou art I...

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: Thou who art willing to perform all[n]sacrilegious acts for thine own justice!

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: Call upon my name, and release thy rage!

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: Show the strength of thy will to ascertain all on thine own,[n]though thou be chained to Hell itself!

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: Execute him!
That's enough!
I will stop you.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: What was that...?

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: You desire to be killed that much? Fine!

entries.speaker: (SE)主人公
entries.en: Nngh...
